releaseNotes: Routed the 60fps.design MCP into the design phase beyond the onboarding lane it already served (ONB-08), availability-gated at catalog altitude: the Design Room node grounds screen and interaction direction in real exemplars before locking states (60fps_search_shots, 60fps_get_shot, 60fps_get_motion_breakdown, recorded in design/design.md), the premium-mobile-craft node grounds motion-craft-benchmarks recipes in live shots before applying them, and the landing build node grounds hero/scroll/micro-interaction choices in exemplars re-expressed on the web --motion-* scale. When the MCP is not connected, the distilled recipes and section library remain the contract and searching is not required.

Matched the knowledge layer to the new catalog routing: design-visual-system.md step 6a now names the exemplar-grounding step for in-app screens, landing-motion-craft.md gained a live-exemplar paragraph that routes through motion-craft-benchmarks.md's Live Catalog Access section (search and breakdown tools only — 60fps_get_motion_code's SwiftUI starter has no web target), and that Live Catalog Access section now states both lanes' rewrite targets (DesignTokens.Motion in-app, motion/react on --motion-* for landing) so the two docs cannot drift apart.
